title: Hit Box Attributes
description: Defines one hit box of a sub-part: collision shape, armor thickness, the referenced hit box material and per-hit-box material overrides. Overrides use the same physics / armor / sounds groups as the material definition; every override field is optional and an omitted field keeps the material value.

id.description: Hit box id. Hit boxes sharing an id are not hit twice by the same attack.

type.description:
Collision shape type.
- box: box generated from the cube pose and half-extents.
- sphere: sphere using the cube y half-length as radius.
- cylinder: cylinder generated from the cube pose and half-extents, axis is z.
- capsule: capsule generated from the cube pose and half-extents, axis is y.
- wheel: sphere using the cube y half-length as radius and the x size as width; contacts beyond half-width are ignored and the rigid body inertia tensor is adjusted with the cylinder formula. Prefer a single wheel hit box holding a single cube per sub-part.

subsystem.description: Subsystem name. Damage taken by this hit box is applied to the named subsystem as well.

module.description: Module name inside the subsystem, for example "barrel", "breech", "radiator". An empty string applies to the subsystem as a whole.

material.description: Material registry id, used to obtain friction coefficients, damage reduction, hit sounds and other physical properties.

thickness.description: Armor thickness, unit mm. Reduces damage and controls energy distribution during collisions.

condition.description: Activation condition, a molang expression deciding whether the hit box is active, for example glass losing its hit box once broken or a trailer jack losing it when deployed.

overwrite.description: Material override applied on top of the referenced material.

physics.description: Physics override: friction, slip, elasticity and block damage.

friction.description: Friction coefficient vector [x, y, z]. x = lateral, y = forward, z = unused.

slip_adaptation.description: Slip adaptation coefficient, adjusts friction behaviour during sliding.

kinetic_scale.description: Friction scale in the high-slip kinetic region.

lateral.description: Lateral slip-angle curve, angles in degrees.

kinetic_angle_deg.description: Slip angle where the kinetic plateau begins.

base_scale.description: Friction scale at zero slip angle.

kinetic_scale.description: Friction scale in the high-angle kinetic region.

block_damage_factor.description: Block damage factor; 0 = cannot break blocks.

armor.description: Armor override: penetration resistance, damage reduction, durability decay and conditional modifiers. Pipeline: damage_modifiers -> (damage - dmg_resist) * dmg_mult.

rha.description: Penetration resistance coefficient relative to RHA (rolled homogeneous armor).

angle_effect.description: Whether equivalent armor thickness is affected by the impact angle.

dmg_resist.description: Linear damage reduction applied before dmg_mult, decayed by durability.

dmg_mult.description: Damage multiplier applied after dmg_resist, decayed by durability.

decay_rha.description: Residual RHA coefficient once durability reaches zero.

decay_dmg_resist.description: Residual linear damage reduction once durability reaches zero.

decay_dmg_mult.description: Residual damage multiplier once durability reaches zero.

decay_power.description: Armor degradation curve exponent; larger than 1 degrades slowly at first and quickly near failure, 1 degrades linearly.

unpen_power.description: Damage exponent used when the attack fails to fully penetrate: damage * (penetration / equivalent armor) ^ unpen_power.

impact_modifiers.description: Impact modifiers, converting received damage into impact applied to connection points.

penetration_modifiers.description: Penetration modifiers, adjusting penetration depth according to the received damage.

damage_modifiers.description: Damage modifiers, adjusting the received damage according to its kind.

hit_un_pen.description: Sound event played when the hit does not penetrate.

hit_pen.description: Sound event played when the hit penetrates.
